Loss report: gitea -> concourse
[emulated] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: worker tags of the task (the tasks carry the worker tags ubuntu-latest; a build waits until a worker has them)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build trigger.push: workspace from the first triggering resource (the tasks run in the checkout of source-tags, and every build uses the newest version of each resource, so a push to source-tags-2 builds the newest commit of source-tags)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.tags: one git resource per tag pattern (each of the patterns v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+, !v*-rc* is its own git resource)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
